mintAuthority.summary: inALPHA is a non-upgradeable BoringVault on Ethereum and Plume. Shares are minted only via the enter() function, which requires authorization from a RolesAuthority contract (0x5e500500968388a13b3ff885c3eed7158a5d82ef). The current authorized Teller is TellerWithMultiAssetSupportPredicateProxy (0x20428f901a50ec69f5a2b56d313491cc686fafff) on both deployments. Vault owner is a 3-of-6 Gnosis Safe (0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982). Native issuance is assessed here; Nest's separate LayerZero OFT share route belongs in Bridge Risk and remains unresolved pending exact route addresses.

review.evidence: Ethereum and Plume reads on 2026-07-14 confirmed the inALPHA vault at 0x64ab176c...b855 has direct runtime code, zero EIP-1967 implementation/admin slots, no UUPS interface, Safe owner 0xa08a0dc4...a982, and RolesAuthority 0x5e500500...82ef on both chains. The current authorized teller at 0x20428f90...fafff has identical runtime bytecode on both chains, zero EIP-1967 slots, no UUPS interface, the same Safe owner, and role 3 authorization for the vault enter() capability at Ethereum block 25,769,980 and Plume block 87,665,989; the previously authored 0x6104fe10...0cb6 address has no role. The mint-critical vault and teller implementations are therefore immutable on both tracked deployments; the Safe can still change authorization through the separately reviewed RolesAuthority control path. Evidence challenge completed 2026-07-15, cadence claim withdrawn 2026-10-21: Nest publishes issuer-operated NAV and live vault composition, but the exact legacy token's feed has shown no accountant update since 2026-02-23 and no reconciliation of its supply to its positions. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the owner Safe can change authorization without an independent timelock, and issuer-operated NAV data is not independent whole-supply reconciliation or prudential supervision. Reconciliation correction reviewed 2026-10-21: the legacy vault's own public feed does not reconcile supply to backing and has no current cadence. At 2026-10-21T22:16Z /positions returned only 0.410183 pUSD of positive holdings (USDC 0, iSNR 0) while /price returned totalSupply 1.979688 at price 0.9542, i.e. 1.8890182896 USD of liabilities, so the nest-vault-positions adapter carries a 78.3% nav-residual (assets/liabilities 0.217). The last-price-update clock is frozen at 2026-02-23T17:32:59Z on Ethereum and 2026-02-23T17:33:15Z on Plume, 240 days before this review and 80 times the adapter's 3-day source-age budget, so no continuous or periodic cadence is established. Nest's current valuation documentation states that routine NAV updates are handled by Nest operations on an underlying-dependent schedule; the earlier 'hourly NAV' characterisation is withdrawn as unsupported. No independent attestor or prudential supervisor exists. reconciliation is therefore internal-ledger rather than continuous, and known unbounded authority without a qualifying process derives unbounded-adverse. Its positions endpoint names vault 0x64ab176c545bb85eca75d53c3ffcb361deafb855 and discloses only 0.410183 pUSD of positive holdings, while price reports NAV 1.8890182896 and totalSupply 1.979688; last-price-update retains February 23, 2026 timestamps 1771867995 and 1771867979. Current nALPHA at 0x593ccca4c4bf58b7526a4c164ceef4003c6388db is a different token and cannot supply this legacy claim's process evidence. Nest DAO LLC is not established as a prudentially supervised issuer of this token.
